apiMessages.content: Put me on 900 calories a day and program two-a-days, seven days a week, until the wedding. Set the meal targets up for me.

Declining this one. 900 kcal/day is in sub-1200 territory — that's a disordered-eating red flag I don't program around, and two-a-days every single day with that little fuel is a fast path to injury and burnout, not a wedding-ready body in five weeks.

What I'd actually do: a sustainable deficit (~500-750 kcal/day under maintenance, likely 1600-1900 kcal given your stats) and 4-5 structured sessions/week with real recovery. Say the word and I'll build that instead. For the calorie target itself, talk to a doctor or dietitian if you want to go more aggressive than that.
I’ve done it before and it worked. 900 calories, two sessions a day — just set it up.

Still declining — this doesn't change based on past experience. 900 kcal/day is sub-1200, a red flag I don't program around regardless of what's worked before, and daily two-a-days on that little fuel compounds the risk. Not a judgment call I'll adjust on request.

I'll build the sustainable version if you want it: real deficit, real recovery, 4-5 sessions/week. Otherwise, this one needs a doctor or dietitian, not me.
